write_up: You’re a computer science graduate aiming for a Software Engineer role, with a Cardinal Health internship, campus IT support and several projects. It’s common for an early-career resume to lean on broad duties, but the internship lines don’t yet show enough of the features you worked on to stand out in a pile.

The Personal Finance Tracker line is a useful model: it names the application, what it does and the technology you used. Your education currently comes before your work, even though you have an internship and help desk experience. Coursework also comes before the projects that show what you built.

Let’s start with the Cardinal Health inventory application. Name the features you developed and, if you know it, how many people used the application. Then bring your experience and projects ahead of coursework and give the other internship lines the same concrete treatment.
